breaking_changes.BC_description: The partial application feature of applyEach has been removed.
Reference: BREAKING CHANGE: remove partial application feature of applyEach (#1640)
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Instead of using partial application with applyEach, you need to explicitly provide all arguments in the function call.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need more details about what the partial application feature of applyEach was, how it was used before, and specific examples of how to adapt code that used this feature. Additionally, need clarification on which module/namespace contains the applyEach method.

breaking_changes.BC_description: Queues have been changed to be awaitable.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Code that interacts with queues may need to be updated to handle the awaitable behavior.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need detailed information about how queue behavior has changed, which specific queue methods are affected, examples of before and after usage patterns, and how client code should be adapted to work with the new awaitable queues.

breaking_changes.BC_description: Most Async methods return a Promise when the final callback is omitted, making them awaitable.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Code that relies on Async methods without passing a callback may now receive a Promise that can be awaited instead of the previous behavior. Update your code to either continue using callbacks or switch to using await with the returned Promise.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need specific examples of affected methods, their previous behavior when called without a callback, and concrete examples showing how to adapt code to handle the new Promise-returning behavior.

breaking_changes.BC_description: Dropped support for Node 4 and earlier, and many old versions of browsers due to heavy use of ES2015 features.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Upgrade to Node.js version later than Node 4 or a more recent browser version that supports ES2015 features.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need specific information about which ES2015 features are being used that break compatibility, which browser versions are no longer supported, and whether there are any polyfills or transpilation options available for projects that need to maintain compatibility with older environments.

breaking_changes.BC_description: In queue, priorityQueue, cargo and cargoQueue, event-style methods like q.drain and q.saturated are now methods that register a callback, rather than properties you assign a callback to.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Instead of assigning a callback to these properties (e.g., q.drain = callback), you now need to call them as methods with the callback as an argument (e.g., q.drain(callback)). If you don't pass a callback, a Promise is returned that you can await.

breaking_changes.BC_description: Calling callback(false) will cancel an async method, preventing further iteration and callback calls.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: If your code passes 'false' as an error parameter to callbacks, this will now be interpreted as a cancellation signal. Update your code to pass null or undefined as the error parameter if you want execution to continue.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need specific examples of which async methods this affects, how cancellation behaved previously, and concrete examples of before/after code patterns to adapt to this change.

breaking_changes.BC_description: during and doDuring have been removed, and instead whilst, doWhilst, until and doUntil now have asynchronous test functions.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Replace any usage of during/doDuring with whilst/doWhilst or until/doUntil with asynchronous test functions.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need specific examples showing how during/doDuring were used previously and how to adapt this code to use whilst/doWhilst or until/doUntil with asynchronous test functions. Also need details on the exact signature and behavior of the asynchronous test functions.

breaking_changes.BC_description: limits of less than 1 now cause an error to be thrown in queues and collection methods.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Ensure that all limits specified in queue and collection methods are at least 1.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need specific examples of which queue and collection methods are affected, what happened previously when limits less than 1 were used, and concrete examples of how to adapt code that might have used limits less than 1.

breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: If your code relies on memoize to cache error responses, you will need to implement your own error caching mechanism.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need specific examples of how memoize previously handled errors, how it handles them now, and concrete examples of how to adapt code that relied on the previous error memoization behavior.

breaking_changes.BC_description: applyEach/applyEachSeries have a simpler interface to make them more easily type-able. It always returns a function that takes in a single callback argument.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Update your code to use the new interface where applyEach always returns a function that takes a single callback. If you omit the callback, a promise is returned which you can await.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need specific examples showing the old interface of applyEach/applyEachSeries and how code using these methods should be updated to use the new interface. Also need clarification on how this relates to the removal of the partial application feature mentioned in a separate breaking change.

breaking_changes.BC_description: A pure ESM version of Async is available as 'async-es' package, which might affect how the library is imported and used.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: If you need to use the pure ESM version, install and import from 'async-es' instead of 'async'.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Need more information about the differences between the regular 'async' package and the 'async-es' package, what 'pure ESM' means in this context, and how imports would need to be changed when switching between these packages. Also need examples of before/after import statements.
